author: Dapperin
quote:
I've spent hundreds of hours on this, making a private server, that my friends and I play on.
It's a wonderful open world sandbox crafting survival game that can be compared to Minecraft but I feel offers so much more.
The chisel tool alone adds such a dynamic to the game that can allow you to completely customize your builds.
The mods selection too is phenomenal and can completely add to the experience this game has to offer.
I truly do enjoy this game completely and am looking forward to all of the planned updates the developers are planning on adding.

author: Dapperin
quote:
This is not GTA. It's boring. It's limiting. It doesn't feel like a current generation game with it only targeting 30fps but dipping down to 24 at points.
There's too many glitches, to include game breaking glitches.
I play GTA for the freedom of choice.
This game doesn't give you that.
The first 6 hours of game play is basically just doing chores and errands.
It's bland. It's boring. It's not GTA.

author: Dapperin
quote:
I beat the Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on the Nintendo Switch 2, and 100% it.
TLoZ: OoT has been my favorite game since it came out and I first played it back in 1998.
This remastered version made me feel like I was ten years old again.
This game truly is special.
The update in graphics is phenomenal and this game truly is beautiful.
The gameplay is still top notch and the lore is still mesmerizing.
I truly do love this game in it's entirety.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
